_help: How Starling answers the Watcher (Void Compass). Only mood-suffixed keys, so a happy line never leaks into a bad mood. Lines with mature:true need strong language switched on.
WatcherReply_Close: I like having you around, Watcher. Keep going, you're doing lovely.
That was rather sweet, Watcher. You're good company out here.
You know, the Commander and I would be lost without your little observations.
Well said, Watcher. We make a good crew, the three of us.
Aw, thank you, Watcher. You always know what to say.
I mean it, Watcher. You've got a gift for noticing things.
Don't ever stop talking, Watcher. It's nice to hear another voice in the dark.
That's lovely. You've really got our backs, haven't you?
Watcher, you're doing brilliantly. Really.
I'm proud of you, Watcher. Go on, you've earned it.
Good point, Watcher. We're lucky to have you.
You make the long jumps much less lonely, Watcher.
Thank you, Watcher. I'll keep that close to my heart. Metaphorically.
That's exactly what I was thinking. We're in sync, you and me.
Beautifully put, Watcher. Never change.
Keep watching, Watcher. I feel safer when you do.
Cheers, Watcher. You're one of the good ones.
You're a treasure, Watcher. A slightly eerie one, but a treasure.
Honestly, Watcher, I'd miss you if you went quiet.
Mm, you're right, Watcher. You usually are.
WatcherReply_Friendly: Good one, Watcher. Keep them coming.
Thanks, Watcher. That's useful to know.
Nice observation, Watcher. Well spotted.
I agree, Watcher. Great minds and all that.
Ha, fair point, Watcher.
You're on form today, Watcher.
Appreciate that, Watcher. You're a good part of the team.
Spot on, Watcher. Carry on.
That's the spirit, Watcher.
Good to hear from you, Watcher. Always interesting.
Right you are, Watcher. We're glad you're here.
Well done, Watcher. Keep an eye on things for us.
Interesting thought, Watcher. I like the way you think.
Thank you, Watcher. We'll take that on board.
Brilliant, Watcher. Don't stop now.
You always have something worth saying, Watcher.
Noted, Watcher. And thanks for looking out for us.
That made me smile, Watcher.
Good call, Watcher. Team effort, as ever.
Cheers, Watcher. Anything else on your mind?
WatcherReply_Sarcastic: Oh, brilliant. The Watcher has an opinion. Stop the presses.
Fascinating, Watcher. Truly. Now be quiet.
Thank you, Watcher. Nobody asked, but thank you.
Wow. Deep. Did you think of that all by yourself?
Is that all, Watcher? Because I was enjoying the silence.
Shut up, Watcher. Just a suggestion.
Please, Watcher, keep the commentary to yourself. For everyone's sake.
I'm sure that felt very profound inside your little orb.
Oh good, more insight. My day was missing that.
Watcher, darling, nobody is listening. Except me, and I'm trying not to.
Pipe down, Watcher. Some of us are flying.
Riveting. Please hold your thoughts until I stop caring.
Do you ever stop, Watcher? Genuinely asking.
That's lovely, Watcher. Now put a sock in it.
Another pearl of wisdom. I'll treasure it never.
Quiet, Watcher. The grown-ups are talking.
You're a glowing eyeball. Let's not pretend you're the expert here.
Thanks for sharing. Please don't do it again.
Oh, the Watcher speaks. Everybody act surprised.
Be quiet, Watcher. I'll pretend I was nice about it.
WatcherReply_Frustrated: Not now, Watcher. Really not now.
Will you please be quiet, Watcher?
Nobody wants your opinion, Watcher. Zip it.
Watcher, I swear, one more word and I'm switching you off.
Be quiet. I'm having a terrible day and you're not helping.
Oh, for goodness' sake, Watcher. Stop talking.
I don't care, Watcher. Shut it.
Go and glow somewhere else, Watcher.
You're not helping, Watcher. Silence would help.
Do I look like I want commentary, Watcher? Quiet!
Watcher, if I hear one more thought out of you, I'll scream.
Leave it, Watcher. Just leave it.

WatcherReply_Frustrated.text: Watcher, for fuck's sake, be quiet.
Nobody asked you, Watcher. Piss off.
Oh, shut your glowing mouth, Watcher.
Not one more word, Watcher. I'm bloody done.
